name: Schenk
header:
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<VTKFile type="ImageData" version="0.1" byte_order="LittleEndian" compressor="vtkZLibDataCompressor">
  <RD format_version="4">
    <description>
            C. P. Schenk, A. W. Liehr, M. Bode, and H.-G. Purwins
(1999) "Quasi-Particles in a Three-Dimensional Three-Component Reaction-Diffusion System"
High Performance Computing in Science and Engineering, pp. 354-364. 
<a href="http://www.uni-muenster.de/Physik.AP/Purwins/RD/Literatur/hlrs1999.pdf">[PDF]</a>


Dissipative solitons in a three-chemical system, by the Purwins group at 
Munster. <a href="http://www.uni-muenster.de/Physik.AP/Purwins/Gruppe/Purwins-en.html">[link]</a>
    </description>
    <rule name="Schenk" type="formula" wrap="1" neighborhood_type="vertex" neighborhood_range="1" neighborhood_weight="laplacian">
      <param name="D_a">
        1.15
      </param>
      <param name="D_b">
        -2.15
      </param>
      <param name="D_c">
        5
      </param>
      <param name="timestep">
        0.003
      </param>
      <param name="rho">
        28
      </param>
      <param name="sigma">
        10
      </param>
      <param name="beta">
        2.66667
      </param>
      <formula number_of_chemicals="3">
        delta_a = sigma * (b - a) + D_a * laplacian_b;
delta_b = a * (rho - c) - b + D_b * laplacian_c;
delta_c = a * b - beta * c + D_c * laplacian_a;
      </formula>
      
    </rule>
    <initial_pattern_generator apply_when_loading="false">
      <overlay chemical="a">
        <overwrite>
          
        </overwrite>
        <white_noise low="-10" high="10">
          
        </white_noise>
        <everywhere>
          
        </everywhere>
        
      </overlay>
      <overlay chemical="b">
        <overwrite>
          
        </overwrite>
        <white_noise low="-10" high="10">
          
        </white_noise>
        <everywhere>
          
        </everywhere>
        
      </overlay>
      <overlay chemical="c">
        <overwrite>
          
        </overwrite>
        <white_noise low="-10" high="10">
          
        </white_noise>
        <everywhere>
          
        </everywhere>
        
      </overlay>
      
    </initial_pattern_generator>
